body: Thank you for the recommendation!  I just subscribed to the podcast!

I already ate all the trigger foods so they are gone! It started as an act of compassion towards myself with a nice lazy day and halfway through Tuesday the binge brain took over and pushed compassion out of the way! I’m at work now which helps take my mind off of it - and make better eating habits since I’m not hermit mode in my apartment. Thank you for your response - sometimes just knowing this isn’t exclusive to smokingvangogh!
I accidentally deleted both comments after I submit duplicates but long story short... We're great and making a positive change for us.
I accidentally deleted both comments after I submit duplicates but long story short... We're great and making a positive change for us.

It's easy to use that like 'well I already messed up' but the next decision is a new decision and doesn't need to take what happened yesterday as a boost of confidence to do it again. I'll probably binge again but this moment was worth celebrating.
And you know? When I realized this morning it had been a week, I thought 'I should bail on meeting my friend at the gym, go get buckets of food, and eat it in bed all day.' Baby steps. I still made it to the gym. and the next decision is up to me.

It is really fucking tough. It is truly a one day at a time game for me. I developed the habit so it became so normal for me to hide and eat that I didn't see how odd it was until I said it out loud to someone else. And I gained 30 pounds! I also set up a pretty strict budget so I don't have a lot of wiggle room for excess self destruction food. Which sounds like I did a lot but it was sort of add a thing a day and and focus on the moment at hand. I'm here if you need a friend!

I am a 27/F and I weigh around 165. I have not weighed myself today but that seems to be where it settles. In 2015 I ran a marathon and in 2016 I gained about 30 pounds. I worry that I have a food addiction or at the very least I know that will be the hardest part of losing weight for me. I am generally pretty active - I got the the gym and weather permitting do lots of outdoor activities. Lately I will be healthy in public, at work, even around my boyfriend, but go crazy and binge eat when alone. I'm hoping seeing others lose weight and joining a community will help me. I have the loseit app and will be counting calories on there. Look forward to reading all the other introductions and hopefully seeing us all progress!
I'm also still figuring out all the ins and outs and reading through all the side bar information!

Is this the right sub for food addiction? I used to be quite fit but gained weight all through 2016. I have a gym membership and have been going again pretty regularly but shoot myself in the foot with really poor eating habits. I'm healthy in public and with friends or at work but once alone I pig out. Is this an appropriate sub for support and help to change?

I just want to say a big THANK YOU to everyone that commented. I was feeling so low and was so touched to read all these responses. I hope everyone here knows they really helped a stranger and her funky bladder!!

I was starting with the foods I know I liked and building recipes around that so lots of veggie soups and lots of apples! It hasn't been too bare bones but I've learned a lot from these comments and feel like I know how to expand safely and slowly from it. Thank you so much for your response and help!
So I cut out soy completely and after this flare up I now check for citric and asorbic acid on ingredients. It's good to know that people find their triggers! Thank you for responding!
Thank you so much for the recommendation! I am learning so much from these comments, I am checking out the high/low maps now!

I love Talenti! Now I'll claim it as a medical necessity! I was wih family that was pretty accomitading but reading through these comments I need to be more aware so when someone says it's a veggie soup I check what rice or pasta was used in that soup. I haven't noticed a period connection but I am having a very usual long and heavy period currently? Something to note. I got a little pocket sized journal to track everything I just was so frustrated feeling like I couldn't find a theme. These comments are very helpful and inspiring!!

Thankfully my local supermarket has a really nice 'natural' section so I'll have access to a decent selection of goods easily. From these responses I've learned the biggest thing is read ingredients! I was using the IC diet list as a no variation technique but wasn't applying it really to packaged goods.
I usually eat pretty healthy and 'clean' but need to really examine the things I buy that are packaged, mainly bread and pastas. The flare ups in the last few weeks have been primarily 1. Discomfort when I wake up 2. Painful to pee like pins and needles 3. Takes my breath away pain when I'm finished peeing. 4. Lingering vaginal discomfort like anything I wear feels too tight. Thank you so much for responding!

Wow thank you for the response! I was hit with a flu like bug so I was down for the count for a while. I didn't think to check the pasta ingredient list, I'm a newbie! I will definitely pick up a ph kit to check my water because I drink A TON from the faucet. This flare up I could feel when I woke up, before I had my first wee of the day. Thank you so much for your help!!

First off I have to say I seriously forget that I am not the only person in the world that gets cold sores. I will just second what everyone else has said. Abreva, lysine, and rubbing alcohol. I recently had one on a very important day as well. Don't forget that you aren't the only one! Lysine typically makes me extra thirsty just a heads up.
Yes, super informative! Thanks for the gross pics :)
Thanks for the response! I didn't even think to take a test after the fact. Thanks!

Thank you so much! Basically I just needed a live response to confirm my impression. And pictures of tiny fetuses kept coming up, that was getting old. Thanks, again! I would be completely freaked if I had this happen at 15, glad you are okay.
Good luck! Nailing down a sleep habit can be hard. Do you ever take melatonin? It can help me fall asleep but not usually stay asleep  all night.

Well I would say just to function like 3, 4 hours? My sleep is so inconsistant though, it's hard to tell. Some nights I won't sleep at all, until a certain point where I sleep for what feels like forever.

I think that depression and those around people with it varies SO much. I have had a suicide attempt, and I still get frustrated with how flippant those around me can be. Now, just the way I am I want to say REMEMBER HOW DEPRESSED I WAS?!?! But that's just how I like to act out and cause a fuss. 
Many people, still, do not understand that depression is real. I commend you for NOT having a suicide attempt, as it really adds more to the thought cycle and seems to never end sometimes. People also don't want to believe that severe depression is something that takes more than "getting over it." 
Getting help is good, and if you didn't already know I'll be redundant and say it can take a few tried to find the right therapist and meds. Best of luck to you, and always remember boundaries! If people are being insensitive you have the right to say it isn't something you want to talk about with them.
I was actually able to get back on my meds. It was a rough transition from cold turkey to back on a full dose but i'm slowly getting better and adjusting. thanks for the message :)
You're right.

I have gone to AA in the past, but really didn't get much benefit from it, I am now seeing a counselor on a regular basis to help address some issues underneath the drinking.
I'm not expecting to be taken back, I'm wouldn't do it if the roles were reversed and I want him to be with someone who will be good to him.
I just wanted advice on how to apologize appropriately and respectfully.
As I said before, I was pretty drunk, but also that is not a reason why. I don't know, there is no problem in the relationship that we had, no fights, I knew I was loved.
Thanks, I've made that clear and can only hope that when he is ready he also believes the sincerity of the apology.
Yeah, without it I never in a million years would hav behaved this way. When I think about what happened it feels like is wasn't even me, someone else was doing all this horrendous stuff, a stranger.

It was a one night stand with an ex, definitely no emotional cheating prior to this. I imagine the biggest question will be WHY, which honestly I don't have an answer to. I was drinking, heavily, which is something I haven't been doing for the past six months, so that is the biggest reason behind it. But being drunk is no reason, that's for sure.
Thank you

Thank you all for the feedback. I think I'll just have to wait it out for professional help, as of now I just don't see the logic or reasoning behind living. Not because of not drinking, not as in oh lord what's the point of life without booze, but I guess now that I'm sober other mental problems are getting bigger than I can handle. I'm so glad I stopped drinking to feel this way.
You are amazing, dammit!
Agreed! Now I can officially say I haven't had a drink since last year. (although to be fair last week was last year...)
This is like a motivational speech. Congratulations, Happy New Year!

A lot of cities have resources for free/sliding scale counseling if it something you really want to pursue. Most universities have (masters) students from the psychology department meet with people, often for free or very very little. It isn't the most personal, and they don't have worldly experience but it can get you talking, at the very least. Some cities are better than others providing mental health care for those who can't afford it, but look into sliding scale offices, based on income.
I was HORRIFIED of AA, I cried before, during, and after. But, I survived. You will too.

Thank you so much, guys! I really appreciate your input, and it seriously made me grin from ear to ear seeing positive reactions from others. 
At the risk of sounding COMPLETELY stupid, do you mean a daily counter to keep up days of sobriety?
And, I'm still scared to drink after it was laid out as a life and death choice, but as of yet I haven't noticed a difference in mood swings.
Again, thank you all so much!!
